thesisCurrent.summary: A validation-stage consumer civic-tech product that turns an issue into a researched, cited, delivered constituent letter for implemented prices from $5.00 to $25.00.
thesisCurrent.posture: watchlist; personal/research asset; not near-term investible BOS until operator and market validation clear.
basis: Implemented product surfaces exist in the repo.

customerDefinition.primary: US resident with a specific civic issue who wants officials contacted but does not want to do legal research, drafting, and routing manually.
excluded: Legal claimants seeking advice or filings
Business entities acting in an official capacity
Users submitting threats, harassment, defamation, or unverifiable misconduct claims

holes: Demand may not exist at any implemented price.
Government email deliverability may fail despite a completed product.
Citation hallucination or misleading legal framing can destroy trust.
Moderation and legal-adjacent review may exceed a lean operator's capacity.
Platform providers may treat civic advocacy as risky or political content.
mitigations: Run paid beta before SEO expansion.
Audit official lookup and delivery logs manually by jurisdiction.
Sample generated letters for citation verification before delivery scale.
Measure queue size, oldest flagged item age, and operator review minutes.
Keep legal advice, filings, bulk advocacy, and business-entity submissions out of scope.
residualRisks: Paid demand remains unknown until real users pay.
Provider policy interpretation can change without warning.
External legal and official-contact data sources can degrade or become unavailable.
